headline: As of 2026-11-05: 69,632,149 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 69,632,149 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (9,305,860), Florida (8,329,717), Texas (8,173,832).
